welcome.tagline: Everything you subscribe to. In one place.

login.title: Log in
login.introduction: Use the trusted simulator to verify a registered account in private development.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.introduction: Choose how your private profile appears.
profile.invalid: Check your profile details and try again.
profile.uncertain: The save could not be confirmed. Your current profile was loaded again.

mode.title: Choose how to start
mode.description: Keep your subscriptions private to you.
mode.incomplete: Complete your profile before choosing Just me.
mode.uncertain: Your choice could not be confirmed. Please try again after a fresh verified login.

manualSubscription.title: Add subscription
manualSubscription.introduction: Record a private subscription manually. Amount and date are expected values, not proof of payment.
manualSubscription.name: Subscription name
manualSubscription.uncertain: This save could not be confirmed. Check this save before starting another.
manualSubscription.readError: The save is committed, but its details could not be loaded. Retry the readback.
manualSubscription.invalid: Review the fields and save a new request.
manualSubscription.receiptConflict: This save conflicts with an earlier request. Review your subscriptions before adding again.
manualSubscription.invalidName: Enter a name of 1–120 characters without control characters.
manualSubscription.invalidAmount: Enter a positive SEK amount with up to two decimals, without grouping.
manualSubscription.invalidDate: Enter a real date as YYYY-MM-DD (year 0001–9999).

ownerSubscriptionList.noMatch: No matching subscriptions. Try another name or category.
ownerSubscriptionList.expectedSubtotal: Active expected amounts per saved billing cycle

ownerSubscriptions.title: Your subscriptions
ownerSubscriptions.unavailable: Your subscriptions could not be confirmed. A fresh verified login is required.
ownerSubscriptions.rechecked: The update could not be confirmed. The current saved status was loaded again.
ownerSubscriptions.conflict: The saved status differs from the requested status. Review it before another change.

nativeSubscriptionEdit.conflict: This subscription changed. Your draft is preserved. Review the saved values before saving again.
nativeSubscriptionEdit.tracking: These actions update tracking only. They do not cancel your provider subscription.
nativeSubscriptionEdit.statusSaved: Tracking status saved and read back.

nativeRenewals.title: Expected renewals
nativeRenewals.expected: Saved active subscriptions expected today and over the next 29 days. Dates and amounts are saved expectations, not confirmed charges. Refresh to read the latest saved subscriptions.
nativeRenewals.empty: No saved active renewal dates in this 30-day window.
nativeRenewals.setup: Complete your profile and choose Just me before viewing renewals.

billingMonth.title: Billing month
billingMonth.expected: Expected subscriptions. Saved dates and amounts are estimates, not charges.
billingMonth.empty: No active saved dates in this month. Missing dates remain unknown.
billingMonth.dayEmpty: No saved expected subscriptions on this date.
billingMonth.subtotal: Subtotal of saved expected dates, by currency

nativePersonal.title: Your personal subscriptions
nativePersonal.introduction: Set up your private profile to get started.
nativePersonal.manageDescription: Your subscriptions are private to you. Add or update expected amounts and dates here.
nativePersonal.demo: Development simulator: fresh BankID verification uses the synthetic Alice account. This is not real BankID.
nativePersonal.restart: App restart requires fresh verified login. Your saved subscriptions stay in the database.
nativePersonal.unavailable: The outcome could not be confirmed. Start a fresh verified login and read your saved data before trying again.
nativePersonal.storageError: Secure storage is unavailable. Private data and usable credentials have been cleared.
nativePersonal.logoutLocal: Signed out locally. Server revocation could not be confirmed.
nativePersonal.logoutConfirmed: Logged out and server revocation confirmed.
nativePersonal.name: Display name
nativePersonal.saved: Saved subscription confirmed from current database data.
nativePersonal.readbackUnavailable: The save committed, but this row has not appeared in the current page. Read current subscriptions before another save.
nativePersonal.invalid: Review the fields and enter valid values.

manualEdit.title: Edit manual subscription
manualEdit.introduction: Update the expected details. Your subscription status stays as it is.
manualEdit.stop: Stop editing and return to verified login
manualEdit.confirmed: Changes saved and confirmed from current subscription data.
manualEdit.readOnly: This manual subscription uses a currency or cadence that cannot be edited here.
manualEdit.positiveRequired: Enter a positive expected SEK amount to replace the existing nonpositive amount.
manualEdit.conflict: This subscription changed while you were editing. Your draft is preserved. Review the current details before trying again.
manualEdit.gone: This subscription is no longer available. Return to the current list.

nativeBank.title: Bank connections
nativeBank.demo: Synthetic Demo bank only. The bank data is fictional and stored privately for this test account. No real bank is contacted and subscriptions are not created automatically.
nativeBank.setup: Complete your profile and select Just me before using Demo bank.
nativeBank.purgeWarning: Remove this connection’s fictional accounts and transactions? This cannot be undone. Your manual subscriptions remain unchanged. Linked subscription data can prevent removal.
nativeBank.unavailable: Bank state is unavailable. Verify again to read current state.
nativeBank.uncertain: The operation outcome could not be confirmed. Verify again and read current bank state before choosing another action. No operation was retried.
nativeBank.conflict: The operation conflicted with current bank state. The latest saved state is shown; review it before choosing another action.
nativeBank.purged: Removal confirmed. Current retained connections are shown.

nativeDetection.title: Review subscriptions
nativeDetection.demo: Scan your synced Synthetic bank data. Only you can review these suggestions.
nativeDetection.setup: Complete your profile and choose Just me before reviewing subscriptions.
nativeDetection.empty: No subscriptions are waiting for review.
nativeDetection.deadline: Undo deadline from the server: %{date}. The server checks whether Undo is still available.
nativeDetection.scanned: Scan complete. Suggestions were read from your account.
nativeDetection.reviewed: Review saved and current account state checked.
nativeDetection.undone: Review undone and current account state checked.
nativeDetection.expired: The server’s Undo window has expired. Current account state was refreshed.
nativeDetection.conflict: This suggestion changed. Current account state was refreshed.
nativeDetection.readback: The saved result could not be verified in current account state. Refresh before continuing.
nativeDetection.uncertain: The result is uncertain. Verify again to read current account state. The action will not be retried.
nativeDetection.unavailable: Subscription review is unavailable. Verify again to reload your account.
nativeDetection.undatedDescription: These subscriptions have no saved billing date and are excluded from this month’s totals.
